TWO SIDES, ONE PLATFORM
Built for both sides in Recruitment

Companies post roles and pay when the candidate starts the job. Recruiters pick the assignments they want and are paid per hire.

For Companies
Read more
about hiring through Recruiting Rewards
20 days
average time to hire
From published role to a signed hire in 20 days on average, instead of the six to eight weeks an agency search takes. Candidates arrive within days; from there your own process sets the pace.
30-45%
lower cost than an agency
You set the reward yourself, and it lands below the 20 to 25% of annual salary agencies invoice. Our fee sits inside that reward.
7/10
match score before a candidate reaches you
Anyone scoring under the line is held back, unless the recruiter makes a deliberate case for them, and then reviewed by our team before you see them. The technology finds and ranks, the recruiter judges, and a specialist has interviewed everyone you do see.
One
place for the whole process
Ad writing, screening questions, kanban pipeline, interview booking and messages all sit in the same platform.

Post the role once and several specialist recruiters in your industry take it on. You compare candidates in one place and pay only when the candidate starts the job.

Always free until the job starts
For Recruiters
Read more
about taking assignments through Recruiting Rewards
70-80%
of the reward is yours
Your share depends on your plan, and the reward is stated in the assignment before you accept it.
New every week
assignments from Nordic companies
Tech, sales, marketing and leadership roles land in the marketplace with the reward stated up front.
Zero
cold calls and pitch decks
Companies publish the brief and the reward. You decide which assignments to take on and when.
One
workspace for every assignment
Pipeline, notes, messages and status updates in one place instead of spread across inboxes and spreadsheets.

One workspace for your assignments, candidates and client conversations, with open roles across the Nordics.

How It Works

Over 200 specialist recruiters work assignments through Recruiting Rewards.

4 simple steps. From assignment to paid reward

A straight path from picking an assignment to getting paid for the hire.

1
2
3
4
1. Pick assignments

Browse live assignments in the marketplace and take on the ones that match your niche, your network and your calendar.

2. Submit candidates

Present screened candidates with your own written motivation. The company reads your assessment next to the CV.

3. Collaborate

Interview feedback, messages and status changes stay in one thread, so you always know where each candidate stands.

4. Get rewarded

When your candidate starts the job, the reward is invoiced and paid out on the terms you saw before you accepted the assignment.
